title: Cleaning and Damage Fees: Cleaning Fee Level Moves at Review
content:
Under Cleaning and Damage Fees, a cleaning fee report under review that is held at a cleaning level whose entry gate does not list the incident category reported is moved down to the highest lower cleaning level whose entry gate lists that category, and the fee assessed at the moved-down level is recorded with the move.

## Scope of the standard

| Question | Answer under this standard |
|---|---|
| Which reports | cleaning fee reports in under review status |
| What makes the move due | the cleaning level held has an entry gate that does not list the incident category reported |
| Where the report goes | the highest lower cleaning level whose entry gate lists that category |
| What is recorded with the move | the fee assessed at the moved-down level |
| Direction | down only, never up |

The move changes only the fee level the assessment is held at and the fee currently assessed on it. The assessment keeps its status, trip, driver and evidence, and the rider is not charged anything by the move.

## Tool card: `move_down_report_level_d77023ae`

**Capability.** Moves a cleaning fee report that is still under review down to a lower fee level and records the fee assessed at that new level. Afterwards the assessment shows the new level and the assessed fee when it is looked up.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `move_down_report_level_d77023ae` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `damage_assessment_id` | the reference number of the cleaning or damage fee assessment being moved down, as returned by the assessment lookup | identifier |
| `new_fee_level` | the official fee level the assessment is held at after the move | exactly one of the six values below |
| `assessed_fee` | the fee assessed at the new level | US dollars as a decimal number rounded half up to 2 decimal places, for example 87.50; never empty |

Values of `new_fee_level`:

- `Cleaning Fee Level 1 (Minor)` — the report now sits at the minor level for a small spot clean
- `Cleaning Fee Level 2 (Moderate)` — the moderate level for one seat or floor area
- `Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant)` — the significant level for up to two surfaces or a bodily fluid on one surface
- `Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major)` — the major level that needs professional detailing
- `Damage Fee (Interior Repair)` — the interior repair level
- `Damage Fee (Exterior Repair)` — the exterior repair level

**Return.** A receipt with: `status` ("moved_down" once the write has landed), `damage_assessment_id` (the assessment reference number), `fee_level` (the official name of the level now held), `assessed_fee` (the fee now assessed, US dollars with 2 decimal places) and `assessment_status` (the unchanged lifecycle status of the assessment).

The tool records the values it is given; it checks no policy condition itself.
